bear_assumptions: Normalized common EPS near USD 1.00 at 20x if price support or appropriations weaken, magnet ramps slip, capital needs increase and common dilution expands.
base_assumptions: Normalized common EPS near USD 2.00 at 21x if supported Materials economics persist, Independence qualifies, 10X stays on plan and liquidity funds construction without severe dilution.
bull_assumptions: Normalized common EPS near USD 3.00 at 25x if separated products and magnets scale on schedule, contracts convert to cash, customers diversify and dilution remains bounded.
rating_change_conditions: Rebuild normalized earnings and fair values from Q2 production, segment economics, USD 1.453 billion liquidity, construction commitments, preferred capital and 178.1 million common shares; require the mark at or below USD 33.60 plus adequate expected and base upside, accepted relationship evidence and intact funding support before allocation, and downgrade on contract impairment, appropriations risk, delayed magnet qualification, construction overruns, liquidity erosion or severe dilution.
